items.summary: Update the global CSS configuration in frontend/index.css to implement a professional color palette using navy (#1e3a5f), charcoal (#2c2c2c), slate grays (#64748b, #475569), and white (#ffffff) for both light and dark modes, replacing the current warm education-focused colors while maintaining the OKLCH color space format

Update the Tailwind configuration in frontend/tailwind.config.js to align with the new professional color scheme, ensuring all color tokens reference the updated CSS variables for navy, charcoal, slate, and white tones

Refine typography across the application by updating font sizes, weights, and line heights in the Tailwind configuration to create a clear visual hierarchy suitable for a professional SaaS platform, ensuring headings are bold and distinctive while body text remains highly readable

Update the Layout component (frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx) to apply the professional theme styling with refined spacing, modern navigation appearance, and clean header/footer design using the new color palette

Update the HomePage component (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx) with polished professional styling including refined hero section, clean feature cards, and improved visual hierarchy using the new navy, charcoal, and slate color palette

Update the AnalysisFlow component (frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx) with professional styling for the resume upload and job role selection steps, ensuring forms and cards use the new color palette and refined spacing

Update the AnalysisDashboard component (frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx) with professional theme styling for all data visualization cards, metrics display, and results sections using the navy, charcoal, and slate color palette

Update chart components (SkillMatchChart, SkillCategoryChart, ProficiencyGapChart) to use a professional color palette for data visualization with navy, charcoal, slate, and complementary accent colors that maintain clarity and readability

Update the GapAnalysisResults component (frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResults.tsx) to display matching and missing skills with professional card styling, refined badges, and clear visual separation using the new color scheme

Update the RecommendationsDisplay component (frontend/src/components/RecommendationsDisplay.tsx) with professional styling for course recommendations and project suggestions, using clean cards and refined typography

Update the AdminPanel component (frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx) with professional admin interface styling including refined form controls, clean job role cards, and polished CRUD operation buttons using the navy and charcoal color scheme

Update the JobRoleForm component (frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx) with professional form styling including refined input fields, clean skill management interface, and polished validation error displays

Update the ResumeUpload component (frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx) with professional styling for the drag-and-drop zone, upload progress indicator, and file validation messages using refined colors and typography

Update the JobRoleSelector component (frontend/src/components/JobRoleSelector.tsx) with professional card styling for job role options, refined skill badges, and clean selection states using the navy and slate color palette

Update button components throughout the application (LoginButton, DownloadReportButton, and all form buttons) to use a consistent professional button design system with navy primary buttons, charcoal secondary buttons, refined hover states, and appropriate spacing

Update the ProfileSetupModal component (frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModal.tsx) with professional modal styling including refined form fields, clean layout, and polished save button using the new color scheme
